test.command: python -m pytest tests/test_premarket_preflight.py tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py -q; python -m ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_account_bridge.py tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py; python -m mypy src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_account_bridge.py

implemented: Covers market calendar, data entitlement, read-only broker session, disk capacity, archive write probe, effective cost schedule, strategy identity/version, approved risk configuration, and clock skew.
Missing, invalid, stale, or out-of-policy inputs create explicit failed checks and operator-visible reason codes.
Any failed mandatory check returns status NO_TRADE and approved=false in a JSON-compatible record accepted by ForwardSessionRunner.record_preflight.
The immutable report is content-addressed together with its policy, check results, and input snapshot.
Adds an actual local free-space and archive write/fsync/delete probe with explicitly local evidence scope.

LIVE_PAPER bridge can bind a configured premarket provider to exact session date/ID, registered strategy ID/version/code digest, risk-policy digest, account fee-schedule digest/effective date, and pre-decision timestamp.
Generic preflight callback is a supplemental veto only; absent or invalid premarket evidence remains NO_TRADE and cannot be approved by a permissive callback.
blockers: Authoritative live probes are still missing for calendar, entitlement, broker session, cost, and clock; the filesystem probe is local only.
Daily paper launcher does not configure the premarket provider automatically; provider setup remains caller-owned.
No real-market preflight run has been observed or attested.
